body:
# PyreHaven

PyreHaven is a small Minecraft server I built because I wanted a place where you can blow stuff up, raid bases, and go all out in PvP without dealing with a toxic community.  
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/2YroU5iREgk" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Griefing and chaos are part of the fun, but we actually enforce rules against hacking and inappropriate content so it stays enjoyable for everyone.

---

We've got **proximity voice chat built right into the website**, so you can talk to players nearby in-game without installing any mods or extra software.  

We also build our own **custom server-side mods** that add new gameplay features—and since they run on the server, you don't need to download anything.

---

Whether you play on **Java, Bedrock, Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, or mobile**, you can all play together on the same server.  

We use **Geyser** and **ViaVersion** to make full crossplay work seamlessly, so just connect and you're good to go.

---

## Why PyreHaven?

> Do you play Minecraft Bedrock and want to join a Java server?

> Have you ever wanted to use proximity voice chat without installing mods?

> Do you want to join a server where you can fight, grief, and destroy things without the toxic chat and hackers?

> Want to be part of a growing community from the ground up?

---

### If any of these sound like you,  
## **come join PyreHaven.**
